content.text: The debug logs contain plaintext secrets (Postgres password and a live Paygate API token) that have already been shipped to an external log vendor. Rotating these credentials requires the security team (per the ticket), so this needs to be escalated — a simple "turn debug off" answer would leave exposed live credentials in the vendor's store.
